description: What differs from one run of an engine to the next (moqui test-regression, plans/Regression-Test.md). The comparison leaves these out. columns: in every table; tables: whole; tableColumns: by table. reasons: why each entry is here.

reasons.search.otel_*, search.monitor_annotation: the engine's own telemetry: random trace and span ids, and real times; a case's errors still show in its answer
reasons.cluster_member: one row for each engine process, keyed by its random instance id
reasons.visitor: keyed by a random UUID; the visit rows still count
reasons.dev_artifact*: the index of artifacts the engine fills in the background after boot, at no fixed time, with the paths of the runtime copy
reasons.agent_skill.last_updated_date: the time the boot loaded the skill files
reasons.notification_message.message_json, sent_: the boot notice holds the real start time
reasons.search.document_index.created_at: the time the boot made the index
reasons.service_job_run: the real run times, the process id, the trace id, the thread the pool gave, and the times in its messages
reasons.user_account.current_password: the first login hashes the password again with a random salt
reasons.visit.initial_request, session_id, visit: the engine's port, and a random session and visitor
